title: A Falsified Bar-Instability Criterion Reveals an Independent Disk-State Parameter from EFC-Modified Disk Kinematics
description: This Stage-1 empirical test falsifies an EFC-modified Toomre-Q bar-instability criterion on SPARC galaxies (AUC 0.22–0.31 within the physically allowed ζ range), closing the bar-prediction track. In the same data, the minimum EFC-Q (Πmin) within the disk window emerges as a robust disk-state proxy, correlating strongly with stellar surface density (negative) and gas fraction (positive), with replication on an independent xGASS sample.

Pi_EFC.description: EFC-modified Toomre-like stability parameter evaluated locally in the disk; Πmin within [Rd, 3Rd] is used as the disk-window scalar.

kappa_eff.description: Effective epicyclic frequency including an EFC entropy-flow term controlled by coupling \zeta, constrained by \kappa_{\mathrm{eff}}^2 \ge 0.

g_EFC_shear.description: Shear-based proxy for the EFC entropy-gradient used in v0.2 (and v0.1 shear tests); gives the sign needed to reduce \Pi toward instability in disk regions.

g_EFC_v2proxy.description: Original longitudinal proxy for the entropy-gradient in v0.1; empirically yields a stabilizing sign in rising rotation-curve zones and cannot predict bar onset.

key_results.main_finding: EFC-BIC fails as a bar predictor (AUC 0.22–0.31; anti-correlated with SB/SA truth within physical ζ), but Πmin is a strong, reproducible disk-state proxy anti-correlated with log Σ and positively correlated with fgas.
parameters_tested: σR prescription (Jeans Σ-based vs constant fallback)
entropy-gradient proxy (d(v^2)/dr vs v r dΩ/dr shear)
resonance-aware v0.2 window (ILR, CR, swing-X, peaked window)
datasets_used: SPARC rotation curves (N=112 total processed; N=43 with strict SB/SA SIMBAD labels)
SIMBAD morphological types (de Vaucouleurs bar code)

sealed_predictions.statement: Πmin (or its scalar Πproxy) is negatively correlated with stellar surface density (log Σ or log Σ∗) in late-type, rotation-supported disks at z ≈ 0.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Independent surveys (e.g., MaNGA, CALIFA, WALLABY+optical) showing Spearman ρ(Π, log Σ∗) consistent with 0 or > −0.2 across ≥150 disks after uniform processing.

sealed_predictions.statement: Πmin (or Πproxy) is positively correlated with gas mass fraction fgas in late-type disks at z ≈ 0.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Independent H I+optical datasets yielding Spearman ρ(Π, fgas) consistent with 0 or < +0.2 across ≥150 disks with controlled selection and the same Π pipeline.

sealed_predictions.statement: Π is not degenerate with the radial acceleration relation (RAR); it retains independent signal beyond gobs.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Finding high RAR-degeneracy (e.g., R2 ≥ 0.8 between Π and gobs or residual independence tests consistent with zero) in multiple independent samples.

kill_criteria: KC1: In ≥2 independent galaxy samples (each N ≥ 150 disks) processed with the registered pipeline, both correlations vanish or flip sign: |ρ(Π, log Σ∗)| ≤ 0.2 and |ρ(Π, fgas)| ≤ 0.2 (two-sided p > 0.05 after multiple-testing correction).
KC2: Partial-correlation tests show Π carries no residual information once Σ and fgas are included: |ρ(Π, log Σ | fgas)| ≤ 0.1 and |ρ(Π, fgas | log Σ)| ≤ 0.1 across datasets (both within 2σ).

KC3: Robustness failure—reasonable pipeline changes (σR prescription, derivative method, Rd fit variant) alter the sign of ρ(Π, log Σ∗) or ρ(Π, fgas) or shift |ρ| by ≥ 0.3 across datasets, indicating Π is pipeline-dominated.
KC4: Discovery that Π is strongly degenerate with the RAR (R2 ≥ 0.8 with gobs or equivalent), implying Π is not an independent disk-state parameter.

KC5: The physically allowed ζ-range required by κeff^2 ≥ 0 is shown to be incompatible with reproducing the observed Π–state correlations in the majority of disks (e.g., needs ζ beyond ζmax for >50% of galaxies).
